verdict.rationale: Devin's environment docs say you configure it once and every session boots into that known-good state. Blueprints have Devin inspect the repo and generate the needed tools, runtimes and dependencies. Each cloud session gets its own VM, with VPN access to internal package registries and Android, macOS and Windows platform support. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that environments are reliably reproducible, and detail on how explicit setup steps are authored, edited and versioned in blueprints.
